comment: The div/mult knob is a snapped parameter over 0 to 44 with a custom quantity (Clocker.cpp:48-54) printing /256 up to x256, x1 at the centre value of 22. The time signature knob is snapped over 0 to 16 with a quantity printing 2/4 to 15/8 (:41-46). The BPM parameter is configured over 300 to 3000 with a display multiplier of 0.1, which is why it reads 30.0 to 300.0 BPM. The 'On Run' and 'On Stop' menu headings each carry their own Reset Bar and Pulse to RST out items, so those two names appear twice.
